title: Access Migration Harvester Output v1.1
description: Stable schema for the full harvester pipeline output. v1.1 is additive over v1.0: adds the DatabaseManifest.Documentation pointer + DatabaseManifest.FileMap navigation index (Session 2 of harvester-manifest-index-and-batch-readiness, Finding #2), aligns RelationshipDefinition with the typed-record ParentTable/ChildTable shape, aligns TableIndex with IsPrimary/IsUnique/IsRequired + Fields-as-objects, and adds a Body $def + ItemKind-driven branch selection to HarvestedItem so cascaded validation terminates. Old v1.0 documents stay valid against v1.1 — the new fields are optional, and the drift renames mirror the shapes the typed records have shipped all along.

DatabaseManifest.description: Root document for a full database export. Wraps all harvested metadata and enrichment output for one Access database.

SchemaVersion.description: Schema version this document conforms to. Exactly '1.1' for this schema file.

HarvesterVersion.description: Version of the harvester tool that produced this document.

Documentation.description: v1.1 additive: pointer to the interpretation guide + the schema version this document conforms to. Optional so v1.0 documents remain valid against v1.1.

FileMap.description: v1.1 additive: per-category navigation index (count + glob) into the on-disk ir/ tier — lets a binary-only consumer find every per-object file without prior knowledge of the layout. Optional so v1.0 documents remain valid against v1.1.

Forms.description: Form-level enrichment output. One entry per harvested form.

Reports.description: Report-level enrichment output. Same shape as forms.

Queries.description: Query-level enrichment output (D14). One entry per saved query; each includes Sql.Parsed and Sql.Parameters from the Jet SQL parser.

Modules.description: VBA module-level output. One entry per standard or class module.

Tables.description: Table schema metadata. One entry per table.

Relationships.description: Table-level relationships from Access's DAO Relation objects.

ValidationRules.description: Aggregated validation rules from all tables and forms.

RowSourceSpecs.description: Row-source specifications for all combo and list controls.

FunctionClassifications.description: Translation-strategy classifications for all VBA procedures.

EventHandlerClassifications.description: Event-handler classifications for all form and report event procedures.

NavigationGraph.description: Application-wide navigation graph. Null when navigation data was not available.

UnresolvedItems.description: Aggregated manual-review queue across all phases.

Diagnostics.description: Non-blocking harvester-level warnings and informational messages.

Name.description: Database file name without path (e.g., NorthwindDevEdition.accdb).

FilePath.description: Absolute path to the .accdb / .mdb file as harvested.

ExportedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the harvest run.

DocumentationPointer.description: v1.1 additive. Public pointer to the interpretation guide so a binary-only consumer (no access to the harvester repo) can find documentation for the schema this document conforms to.

Url.description: Public URL of the interpretation guide.

SchemaVersion.description: The schema version this document conforms to (mirrors the root SchemaVersion const; redundant on purpose so the pointer is self-contained).

FileMap.description: v1.1 additive. Per-category navigation index. For each manifest category, surfaces the count of per-object IR files and the relative glob to find them. The glob is relative to the directory containing manifest.json. Modules are surfaced at manifest.Modules but live on disk under ir/ModulesAndClasses/ — the glob reflects the on-disk path.

Count.description: Number of per-object IR files on disk for this category.

Glob.description: Relative glob (relative to the directory containing manifest.json) to locate the per-object IR files.

FormExport.description: Combined form/report enrichment export: the form spec plus its per-procedure parser output.

ParserOutput.description: Parser output for the form/report's VBA class module. Null when the form has no code-behind.

ModuleExport.description: VBA standard or class module: its parser output plus function classifications.

TableIndex.description: v1.1 corrective: renamed Primary/Unique/Foreign to IsPrimary/IsUnique/IsRequired matching the long-shipping TableIndex typed record; Fields items are now objects (IndexField) rather than bare strings to carry per-column IsDescending + Attributes.

IndexField.description: v1.1 corrective: one column reference inside a TableIndex; matches the AccessHarvester.Access.IndexField typed record.

Name.description: Column name; matches a TableField.Name on the parent table.

IsDescending.description: True when this column is sorted descending in the index (decoded from DAO dbDescending, 0x1).

Attributes.description: Raw per-index-column Attributes bitmask, preserved so consumers can decode bits this schema does not promote.

RelationshipDefinition.description: v1.1 corrective: required keys are now Name + ParentTable + ChildTable matching the long-shipping RelationshipMetadata typed record. The per-field pair inside Fields is also renamed (Name/ForeignName -> ParentField/ChildField). v1.1 additive properties (IsEnforced/CascadeUpdate/CascadeDelete/IsInherited/IsUnique/JoinType) surface the derived flags the typed record already emits, so consumers can read them without re-decoding the raw Attributes bitmask.

JoinType.description: One of Inner / LeftOuter / RightOuter (decoded from DAO Attributes bitmask).

Attributes.description: Raw DAO Attributes bitmask, preserved verbatim.

RelationshipFieldPair.description: v1.1 corrective: one pair of joined columns in a RelationshipDefinition. Matches the AccessHarvester.Access.RelationshipFieldPair typed record.

ParentField.description: Column name on the parent (primary-key-side) table.

ChildField.description: Column name on the child (foreign-key-side) table that references the parent column.

ParserOutput.description: VBA parser output for one module invocation. Replaces the v0 root envelope; renamed to PascalCase (v0→v1 D21).

SourceLocation.description: A source position in a VBA module. Lines AND columns are 1-based (DW-26 / Set 018: the producer normalises the parser's 0-based ANTLR columns to 1-based at projection, matching the line base and the human-editor convention). The span is half-open [Start, End): EndColumn is the column immediately AFTER the last character (EXCLUSIVE), so EndColumn - StartColumn is the character width. Note: the separate unresolved-items.json index carries producer-verbatim columns that are uniformly 0-based (raw ANTLR, all sources), i.e. 1 less than this manifest column for the same reference (DW-27).

StartColumn.description: 1-based start column (column of the first character).

EndColumn.description: 1-based EXCLUSIVE end column (one past the last character); EndColumn - StartColumn = width.

HarvestedItem.description: v1.1 corrective: discriminator-driven branch selection via ItemKind. The v1.0 oneOf evaluated every branch and (with OutputFormat.List) surfaced per-branch failures even when one branch matched, inflating the validator's error count. The allOf+if/then form below short-circuits to the matching branch, so a Procedure item is validated only against ProcedureItem, etc. Required ItemKind discriminator ensures one branch always selects.

ProcedureKind.description: D3: DeclareFunction and DeclareSub added (v0→v1 gap v0-G5).

Visibility.description: D4: renamed from 'visibility' to 'Visibility' (PascalCase, v0→v1 D4).

StartLine.description: D8: flat StartLine shorthand added at procedure level.

Purity.description: v1.1 corrective: added 'LateBound' to match the AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Enrichment.ClassificationCategory enum that ParserOutputProjector emits via PrimaryCategory.ToString(). v1.0 schema omitted it, so any procedure with a LateBound classification failed validation.

PassingMechanism.description: D10: replaces the v0 'byRef: boolean'. ByRefDefault = ByRef with no keyword written.

IsArray.description: True for array-typed parameters (e.g., myArr() As String). Distinct from ParamArray. Added in v0 patch (v0-G1); retained at v1.

ResolutionReason.description: Additive (008 Session 3, F-3-6). Present on Unresolved references only: the resolver's reason for why the name did not resolve. Lets a consumer triage an Unresolved reference (a genuine miss vs. a known capability gap) without re-deriving it. Drawn from the resolver's UnresolvedReasons set, which is append-only (extended, never renamed): currently 'not-in-scope', 'me-in-standard-module', 'default-member-not-yet-resolved', 'with-block-flattening-deferred', 'member-access-on-unresolved-target'. Left as a free string (not an enum) so future reasons remain schema-valid. Optional, so documents without it stay valid.

Connect.description: D13: DAO Connect string (for pass-through queries).

PredicateNode.description: A node in the structured predicate tree (WHERE / HAVING / JOIN ON). NodeKind discriminates the concrete shape. NOTE: The C# PredicateNode hierarchy requires [JsonPolymorphic] / [JsonDerivedType] attributes to emit this discriminator field; see v1-adr.md §Known Issues.

Expression.description: In / IsNull / Between / Like / Opaque: subject expression.

Negated.description: In / IsNull / Between / Like: true when NOT modifier is present.

RibbonEntryPoints.description: Ribbon navigation entry points (016 S2 / DW-13): one record per custom-ribbon callback (every control onAction plus the root onLoad), resolved against the harvested VBA modules. Omitted when Ribbon is null (no custom ribbon contributes nothing, like Ribbon itself, so a non-ribbon corpus stays byte-neutral). Source order: root onLoad first, then a depth-first tabs -> groups -> controls -> children walk, then contextual tab sets.

ChainEdges.description: Cross-object navigation chain edges (R2-2 / DW-10): launcher -> report -> dialog -> query -> parameter relationships derived from embedded macros, record sources, and query parameters.

UnresolvedChainTargets.description: Chain relationships whose far endpoint is dynamic (prompt-style declared parameters, unparseable record sources), surfaced explicitly.

Provenance.description: Closed kebab-case set: vba-call | embedded-macro | macro-action | record-source | query-form-reference | query-declared-parameter | tempvar-flow.

Member.description: The control / parameter / token within Name the relationship is anchored to. Omitted at object granularity.

Reason.description: Closed set: prompt-parameter | record-source-unparsed | embedded-macro-unparsed | unresolvable-reference.

RibbonEntryPoint.description: One custom-ribbon callback (a control onAction or the ribbon root onLoad) resolved against the harvested VBA modules (016 S2 / DW-13). The ribbon analogue of NavigationEntryPoint. Resolution is a case-insensitive name match: Resolved (exactly one match; ResolvedProcedure names module + procedure), Unresolved (no match; surfaced explicitly, never dropped), Ambiguous (more than one match; ResolvedProcedure omitted, no module guessed). Design note: docs/session-sets/016-ribbon-navigation-surface/s2-ribbon-entry-point-consensus.md.

Kind.description: Whether the callback is a control onAction or the ribbon root onLoad.

CallbackName.description: The callback procedure name exactly as authored in the ribbon XML onAction/onLoad attribute; preserved verbatim even when unresolved.

ControlType.description: The owning control's element type (button/dropDown/...); omitted for the root onLoad entry.

ControlId.description: The owning control's custom id; omitted for the root onLoad or a built-in idMso control.

ControlIdMso.description: The owning control's built-in idMso; omitted for the root onLoad or a custom id control.

ControlLabel.description: The owning control's display label; omitted when absent.

ResolvedProcedure.description: Module + declared procedure name when Resolution is Resolved; omitted for Unresolved and Ambiguous.

RibbonStructure.description: Custom ribbon parsed from USysRibbons customUI XML by RibbonXmlParser (016 / DW-13). A faithful recursive tree: custom (id) AND built-in (idMso) tabs/groups/controls are surfaced, nesting is preserved via RibbonControl.Children, and any attribute with no typed slot is preserved verbatim in source order on the node's Attributes bag (the parser does not interpret imageMso / sizes / dynamic get* callbacks beyond surfacing the static onAction). Id/Label are nullable because built-in idMso nodes carry neither. Design note: docs/session-sets/016-ribbon-navigation-surface/s1-ribbon-model-consensus.md.

Name.description: The USysRibbons.RibbonName of the surfaced row (e.g. 'Main'). When a database defines more than one ribbon row, this names the one surfaced here; all rows are preserved in raw/Navigation/ribbon-xml.json.

OnLoad.description: The customUI@onLoad ribbon-load callback, when present.

Attributes.description: Unslotted attributes of the <ribbon> element (e.g. startFromScratch), source order, verbatim.

ContextualTabSets.description: The <contextualTabs> section's tab sets, source order.

Id.description: Custom id, or omitted for a built-in idMso tab set.

IdMso.description: Built-in idMso, or omitted for a custom tab set.

RibbonTab.description: A ribbon tab. Custom (Id) or built-in (IdMso); both Id and Label may be absent on built-in idMso tabs.

RibbonControl.description: One ribbon control. ControlType is the XML element local name (button, toggleButton, splitButton, menu, dropDown, gallery, comboBox, box, control, menuSeparator, ...). Nested children (a splitButton's button/menu, a box's contents) hang off Children. OnAction is the static VBA callback (a navigation entry point); null when absent (declarative or built-in idMso). Unslotted attributes (imageMso, size, boxStyle, screentip, title, dynamic get* callbacks) ride verbatim on Attributes.

SwitchboardId.description: Page key: the table's ParentID value when it has a ParentID column (hand-rolled hierarchy tables), else the (non-unique) SwitchboardID (canonical Switchboard Manager tables). Not globally unique across multiple switchboard tables — pair with Table.

Table.description: The switchboard-shaped table this page's rows came from (page-level source identity for multi-table corpora).

Name.description: Page display name: the ItemText of the page's lowest-ordered row.

Command.description: Raw, undecoded Command value as stored in the table; meaning is database-specific (the canonical Switchboard Manager 1-8 scheme is only one possibility). Omitted when the row stored no Command (never coerced to 0).

Provenance.description: Per-row provenance tracing this item to its source row.

UnlinkedItemCount.description: Count of materialised switchboard rows that carry no page linkage (null ParentID on a hierarchy table); preserved in the raw row dump but not reflected in Pages. 0 for canonical tables.

Table.description: Switchboard-shaped table the row came from.

SwitchboardId.description: The row's raw SwitchboardID; omitted when the row stored no value (never coerced to 0).

ItemNumber.description: The row's ItemNumber (display order within its page); omitted when the row stored no value.

ParentId.description: The row's ParentID when the table carries that column; absent for canonical tables.

Source.description: Producer discriminator. 'ModuleLevelReference' added 015 S2 (DW-11 Layer B): a module-level VBA unresolved reference (a Const/Dim initializer, an Implements <unresolved>, a module-scope As New <unresolved>) carries ModuleName but null ProcedureName. Enum widened in place on the living v1.1 schema (the UnresolvedItem $def is additionalProperties-tolerant and this adds no property); old documents stay valid and the value only appears when a module-level unresolved reference exists, so no envelope version bump.
